headline: Frontlines Flare as Six Sectors See Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the war's pulse has quickened on several fronts while others have eased. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, though its 24‑hour flip count slipped to 42 from 45 and Colonial losses fell to 6,990 against 10,093 Warden dead; enlistments dipped to 379. Mooring County cooled markedly, with ownership changes halved to ten and casualties dropping to 8,449 Colonial and 9,333 Warden, while fresh troops fell to 876. Palantine Berm surged, logging 13 flips and pushing casualties above 3,000 each side with 878 new enlistees. Stlican Shelf held steady at ten flips, each side suffering roughly 2,000 losses and 397 enlistments. Callahans Passage added a seventh capture, raising its toll to 8,611 Colonial and 9,221 Warden dead and 599 enlistments. A fresh hotspot appeared at Fisherman's Row, where five flips in the past day centered on Oceanwatch and Hangman's Court. Across the rear areas most sectors remain static, reporting no ownership moves. Casualty rates are accelerating on the active fronts, indicating continued pressure on strategic bases.
